description: Perform Bader charge analysis on Sn-substituted alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite) bulk.
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on Sn-doped alpha-Fe2O3 (hematite structure, R-3c) bulk, where one Fe atom in a supercell is substituted by Sn. Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for the Sn dopant atom.

method.modeling: 2x2x1 hexagonal supercell of alpha-Fe2O3 (R-3c, 120 atoms) with one Fe substituted by Sn.

key_parameters.dft+u: Ueff(Fe 3d) = 4.3 eV (recommended); no U on Sn

method.rationale: Value from Pan, Ao & Qin 2020: in a 120-atom Sn-substituted supercell they report the Sn atom provides about 2.28 e to the lattice by Bader analysis. The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol. Tolerance +/-0.20 e absolute.
